posts.title: Announcing DreamCoder
posts.description: I talk about DreamCoder, a frontier coding harness and IDE I have been working on for quite a long time. I also talk about the history of AI, LISP and Emacs, and how it all fits together.

posts.title: What's New in Emacs 31.1?
posts.description: Emacs 31.1 adds a slew of quality-of-life features. It retires its quirky unexec dumper; there are general improvements to tree-sitter, including a much-wanted auto-installer for grammars; and much more.

posts.title: Thoughts on Mechanical Keyboards and the ZSA Moonlander
posts.description: Mechanical keyboards, the nerd equivalent of obsessing over ferrule weights in golf clubs, are wildly popular, and for a good reason. I've owned and used a ZSA Moonlander for some years now, and here are my thoughts on it and why I think you should literally buy any mechanical keyboard you can get your hands on with programmable firmware. Your fingers will thank you.
